lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: YOU HAVE NO IDEA WHAT IS SITTING UNDER THAT ROTTING ROOF [beat] AND IF YOU DO NOT MOVE NOW, WE ARE ALL GOING TO LOSE EVERYTHING!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal [beat] you have been obsessed with this inheritance for years, but the attic just tried to swallow my arm whole when I reached for the light!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Stop talking about that garbage [beat] because your grandfather promised us safety in this home, not a house that breathes when we try to sleep.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Safety is for the poor and the weak [beat] and what is hidden upstairs is a golden ticket that requires a very specific type of family blood to open!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I saw the walls shifting [beat] and I swear I heard Nani’s voice coming from behind the locked trunk even though she is sitting right here in the kitchen!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I always knew this side of the family was cursed [beat] but I did not think you would be stupid enough to actually wake the inheritance up early.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Everyone shut your mouths [beat] because the floorboards are literally glowing and I am not losing this house to some ancient family debt we never signed!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look at the ceiling right now [beat] it is not dust falling anymore, it is old gold coins that are burning holes straight through the living room carpet!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Do not touch those you greedy little brat [beat] because the inheritance only pays out a full reward if we offer the house something it wants first!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Nix, why is the trunk calling my name from the stairs [beat] and why does it sound like it is hungry for something more than just old dusty clothes?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Get away from the stairs Milli [beat] because the locks are melting off the wood and whatever is inside that box doesn't want to be a secret anymore!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: It is too late for us [beat] the contract was signed in breath and bone decades ago, and now the attic is coming down to collect its final prize.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some fortunes are not meant to be spent [beat] they are meant to be survived before they consume every single person left in the family will.
